[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Taypan[/color][/head]
Taypan was a prosperous hub for trade, delivering on the promise made to the Imperial citizenry of purpose and simple living.
It was not glamorous, but it served as the administrative and logistical center of Sector Crescent. Cargo fleets gathered there before travelling deeper into the frontier. Noble families maintained estates and stations within the system, far from the political struggles of the Imperial core.
Retired military officers, merchant houses, and minor aristocrats lived comfortably beneath Imperial protection while overseeing extraction operations across the sector.
Taypan was stable.
Then the Mandate began losing control over the frontier.
